dialogues.speaker: Angry Handwriting
dialogues.text: "The bulletin board is not a target board! You treasure hunters really are a bunch of good-for-nothings!"

dialogues.speaker: Angry Handwriting
dialogues.text: "If you want to practice your marksmanship, go find a range! Don't show off your accuracy here, you're bringing shame to all of Nasha Town!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Whoa... I don't know about y'all, but this is some seriously impressive marksmanship. The word 'not' and the 'no' in 'nothings' have been shot so full of holes they're hard to even read..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Any more of that, and the message is going to turn into 'The bulletin board is a target board! You treasure hunters really are a bunch of good-for... things' or something..."
